# Generated by tools/build_equipment.py.

# Artifact scope: one more grade point.
ac_forge_add_quality_effect = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable = ac_forge_quality } change_variable = { name = ac_forge_quality add = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = ac_forge_quality value = 1 } }
}

# Owner scope: take the strongest Soul Treasure for the forge (scope:ac_forge_treasure_ap).
ac_forge_take_treasure_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = ac_soul_treasure_1 ac_soul_treasure_1_value >= ac_soul_treasure_2_value ac_soul_treasure_1_value >= ac_soul_treasure_3_value }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_forge_treasure_ap value = var:ac_soul_treasure_1 } remove_variable = ac_soul_treasure_1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = ac_soul_treasure_2 ac_soul_treasure_2_value >= ac_soul_treasure_3_value }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_forge_treasure_ap value = var:ac_soul_treasure_2 } remove_variable = ac_soul_treasure_2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = ac_soul_treasure_3 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_forge_treasure_ap value = var:ac_soul_treasure_3 } remove_variable = ac_soul_treasure_3
	}
	else = { save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_forge_treasure_ap value = 0 } }
}

# Player scope: save the forge's scopes for steps and triggers.
ac_forge_save_scopes_effect = {
	save_scope_as = ac_forge_owner
	var:ac_forge_smith ?= { save_scope_as = ac_forge_smith }
	var:ac_forge_item ?= { save_scope_as = ac_forge_item }
}

# Story scope (a step): choose what it does, from what the smith and owner can offer.
ac_forge_pick_node_effect = {
	random_list = {
		4 = { set_variable = { name = ac_forge_node value = flag:temper } }
		4 = { trigger = { NOT = { scope:ac_forge_owner.var:ac_forge_template = flag:armor } } set_variable = { name = ac_forge_node value = flag:hone } }
		4 = { trigger = { scope:ac_forge_owner.var:ac_forge_template = flag:armor } set_variable = { name = ac_forge_node value = flag:plates } }
		3 = { set_variable = { name = ac_forge_node value = flag:fold } }
		2 = { trigger = { NOT = { scope:ac_forge_owner.var:ac_forge_template = flag:armor } } set_variable = { name = ac_forge_node value = flag:balance } }
		2 = { set_variable = { name = ac_forge_node value = flag:decorate } }
		3 = { trigger = { scope:ac_forge_smith = { has_perk = ac_2_handseals_b_perk } } set_variable = { name = ac_forge_node value = flag:reinforcement } }
		3 = { trigger = { NOT = { scope:ac_forge_owner.var:ac_forge_template = flag:armor } scope:ac_forge_smith = { has_perk = ac_3_style_akakiru_f_perk } } set_variable = { name = ac_forge_node value = flag:armory } }
		3 = { trigger = { scope:ac_forge_smith = { has_perk = ac_3_style_kiihakai_g_perk } } set_variable = { name = ac_forge_node value = flag:runes } }
		3 = { trigger = { scope:ac_forge_smith = { has_perk = ac_1_alchemy_f_perk } } set_variable = { name = ac_forge_node value = flag:refine } }
		2 = { trigger = { scope:ac_forge_smith.stewardship >= 10 } set_variable = { name = ac_forge_node value = flag:mat_jade } }
		2 = { trigger = { scope:ac_forge_smith.stewardship >= 15 } set_variable = { name = ac_forge_node value = flag:mat_beastbone } }
		2 = { trigger = { scope:ac_forge_smith.stewardship >= 10 } set_variable = { name = ac_forge_node value = flag:mat_snowsteel } }
		2 = { trigger = { scope:ac_forge_smith.stewardship >= 15 } set_variable = { name = ac_forge_node value = flag:mat_truegold } }
		1 = { trigger = { scope:ac_forge_owner = { ac_holds_soul_treasure_trigger = yes } } set_variable = { name = ac_forge_node value = flag:treasure_athletics } }
		1 = { trigger = { scope:ac_forge_owner = { ac_holds_soul_treasure_trigger = yes } } set_variable = { name = ac_forge_node value = flag:treasure_insight } }
		1 = { trigger = { scope:ac_forge_owner = { ac_holds_soul_treasure_trigger = yes } } set_variable = { name = ac_forge_node value = flag:treasure_persuasion } }
		1 = { trigger = { scope:ac_forge_owner = { ac_holds_soul_treasure_trigger = yes } } set_variable = { name = ac_forge_node value = flag:treasure_deception } }
		1 = { trigger = { scope:ac_forge_owner = { ac_holds_soul_treasure_trigger = yes } } set_variable = { name = ac_forge_node value = flag:treasure_craft } }
		1 = { trigger = { scope:ac_forge_owner = { ac_holds_soul_treasure_trigger = yes } } set_variable = { name = ac_forge_node value = flag:treasure_handseals } }
		2 = { trigger = { scope:ac_forge_smith = { has_trait = ac_element_darkness } } set_variable = { name = ac_forge_node value = flag:infuse_darkness } }
		2 = { trigger = { scope:ac_forge_smith = { has_trait = ac_element_earth } } set_variable = { name = ac_forge_node value = flag:infuse_earth } }
		2 = { trigger = { scope:ac_forge_smith = { has_trait = ac_element_fire } } set_variable = { name = ac_forge_node value = flag:infuse_fire } }
		2 = { trigger = { scope:ac_forge_smith = { has_trait = ac_element_ice } } set_variable = { name = ac_forge_node value = flag:infuse_ice } }
		2 = { trigger = { scope:ac_forge_smith = { has_trait = ac_element_light } } set_variable = { name = ac_forge_node value = flag:infuse_light } }
		2 = { trigger = { scope:ac_forge_smith = { has_trait = ac_element_storm } } set_variable = { name = ac_forge_node value = flag:infuse_storm } }
		2 = { trigger = { scope:ac_forge_smith = { has_trait = ac_element_water } } set_variable = { name = ac_forge_node value = flag:infuse_water } }
		2 = { trigger = { scope:ac_forge_smith = { has_trait = ac_element_wind } } set_variable = { name = ac_forge_node value = flag:infuse_wind } }
	}
}

# Player scope: lay out a fresh board and an unfinished piece of the chosen kind.
ac_forge_create_board_effect = {
	ac_forge_save_scopes_effect = yes
	create_story = { type = ac_story_forge_board save_scope_as = ac_forge_board }
	set_variable = { name = ac_forge_board value = scope:ac_forge_board }
	if = { limit = { var:ac_forge_template = flag:katana } create_artifact = { name = ac_eq_unfinished_katana description = ac_eq_desc_unfinished type = ac_katana visuals = sword creator = scope:ac_forge_smith wealth = 20 quality = 20 modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier save_scope_as = ac_forge_item } scope:ac_forge_item = { remove_artifact_modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forge_template = flag:jian } create_artifact = { name = ac_eq_unfinished_jian description = ac_eq_desc_unfinished type = ac_jian visuals = sword creator = scope:ac_forge_smith wealth = 20 quality = 20 modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier save_scope_as = ac_forge_item } scope:ac_forge_item = { remove_artifact_modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forge_template = flag:tanto } create_artifact = { name = ac_eq_unfinished_tanto description = ac_eq_desc_unfinished type = ac_tanto visuals = dagger creator = scope:ac_forge_smith wealth = 20 quality = 20 modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier save_scope_as = ac_forge_item } scope:ac_forge_item = { remove_artifact_modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forge_template = flag:kunai } create_artifact = { name = ac_eq_unfinished_kunai description = ac_eq_desc_unfinished type = ac_kunai visuals = dagger creator = scope:ac_forge_smith wealth = 20 quality = 20 modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier save_scope_as = ac_forge_item } scope:ac_forge_item = { remove_artifact_modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forge_template = flag:qiang } create_artifact = { name = ac_eq_unfinished_qiang description = ac_eq_desc_unfinished type = ac_qiang visuals = spear creator = scope:ac_forge_smith wealth = 20 quality = 20 modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier save_scope_as = ac_forge_item } scope:ac_forge_item = { remove_artifact_modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forge_template = flag:greataxe } create_artifact = { name = ac_eq_unfinished_greataxe description = ac_eq_desc_unfinished type = ac_greataxe visuals = axe creator = scope:ac_forge_smith wealth = 20 quality = 20 modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier save_scope_as = ac_forge_item } scope:ac_forge_item = { remove_artifact_modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forge_template = flag:kusarigama } create_artifact = { name = ac_eq_unfinished_kusarigama description = ac_eq_desc_unfinished type = ac_kusarigama visuals = dagger creator = scope:ac_forge_smith wealth = 20 quality = 20 modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier save_scope_as = ac_forge_item } scope:ac_forge_item = { remove_artifact_modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forge_template = flag:bo_staff } create_artifact = { name = ac_eq_unfinished_bo_staff description = ac_eq_desc_unfinished type = ac_bo_staff visuals = spear creator = scope:ac_forge_smith wealth = 20 quality = 20 modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier save_scope_as = ac_forge_item } scope:ac_forge_item = { remove_artifact_modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forge_template = flag:meteor_hammer } create_artifact = { name = ac_eq_unfinished_meteor_hammer description = ac_eq_desc_unfinished type = ac_meteor_hammer visuals = hammer creator = scope:ac_forge_smith wealth = 20 quality = 20 modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier save_scope_as = ac_forge_item } scope:ac_forge_item = { remove_artifact_modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forge_template = flag:claws } create_artifact = { name = ac_eq_unfinished_claws description = ac_eq_desc_unfinished type = ac_claws visuals = dagger creator = scope:ac_forge_smith wealth = 20 quality = 20 modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier save_scope_as = ac_forge_item } scope:ac_forge_item = { remove_artifact_modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forge_template = flag:yumi } create_artifact = { name = ac_eq_unfinished_yumi description = ac_eq_desc_unfinished type = ac_yumi visuals = bow creator = scope:ac_forge_smith wealth = 20 quality = 20 modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier save_scope_as = ac_forge_item } scope:ac_forge_item = { remove_artifact_modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forge_template = flag:armor } create_artifact = { name = ac_eq_unfinished_armor description = ac_eq_desc_unfinished type = ac_armor visuals = armor creator = scope:ac_forge_smith wealth = 20 quality = 20 modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier save_scope_as = ac_forge_item } scope:ac_forge_item = { remove_artifact_modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier } }
	scope:ac_forge_item = {
		set_variable = { name = ac_forged_kind value = scope:ac_forge_owner.var:ac_forge_template }
		set_variable = ac_forge_unfinished
	}
	set_variable = { name = ac_forge_item value = scope:ac_forge_item }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_forge_size value = ac_forge_board_size }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_forge_cell_x value = { value = 700 divide = scope:ac_forge_size } }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_forge_cell_y value = { value = 440 divide = scope:ac_forge_size } }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_forge_row value = 0 }
	while = {
		limit = { scope:ac_forge_row < scope:ac_forge_size }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_forge_column value = 0 }
		while = {
			limit = { scope:ac_forge_column < scope:ac_forge_size }
			random = {
				chance = 75
				create_story = { type = ac_story_forge_node save_scope_as = ac_forge_new_node }
				scope:ac_forge_new_node = {
					set_variable = { name = coord_x value = { value = { 0 1 } multiply = { value = scope:ac_forge_cell_x subtract = 60 } add = 30 add = { value = scope:ac_forge_cell_x multiply = scope:ac_forge_column } } }
					set_variable = { name = coord_y value = { value = { 0 1 } multiply = { value = scope:ac_forge_cell_y subtract = 60 } add = 30 add = { value = scope:ac_forge_cell_y multiply = scope:ac_forge_row } } }
					ac_forge_pick_node_effect = yes
				}
				scope:ac_forge_board = { add_to_variable_list = { name = nodes target = scope:ac_forge_new_node } }
			}
			save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_forge_column value = { value = scope:ac_forge_column add = 1 } }
		}
		save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_forge_row value = { value = scope:ac_forge_row add = 1 } }
	}
	# 3 steps become starting points, where the piece is shaped.
	scope:ac_forge_board = { while = { count = 3 random_in_list = { variable = nodes limit = { NOT = { var:ac_forge_node = flag:start } } set_variable = { name = ac_forge_node value = flag:start } } } }
	# Link every pair of nearby steps.
	scope:ac_forge_board = {
		every_in_list = {
			variable = nodes
			save_scope_as = ac_forge_a
			scope:ac_forge_board = {
				every_in_list = {
					variable = nodes
					limit = { NOT = { this = scope:ac_forge_a } NOT = { ac_forge_linked_trigger = { A = this B = scope:ac_forge_a } } }
					save_scope_as = ac_forge_b
					# Squared distance between the two steps.
					save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_forge_d2 value = {
						add = { value = scope:ac_forge_a.var:coord_x subtract = scope:ac_forge_b.var:coord_x multiply = { value = scope:ac_forge_a.var:coord_x subtract = scope:ac_forge_b.var:coord_x } }
						add = { value = scope:ac_forge_a.var:coord_y subtract = scope:ac_forge_b.var:coord_y multiply = { value = scope:ac_forge_a.var:coord_y subtract = scope:ac_forge_b.var:coord_y } }
					} }
					if = { limit = { scope:ac_forge_d2 <= 52000 }
					scope:ac_forge_owner = { create_story = { type = ac_story_forge_line save_scope_as = ac_forge_new_line } }
					scope:ac_forge_new_line = {
						set_variable = { name = start_node value = scope:ac_forge_a }
						set_variable = { name = end_node value = scope:ac_forge_b }
						set_variable = { name = opacity value = 0.25 }
					}
					scope:ac_forge_a = { add_to_variable_list = { name = lines target = scope:ac_forge_new_line } }
					scope:ac_forge_b = { add_to_variable_list = { name = lines target = scope:ac_forge_new_line } }
					scope:ac_forge_board = { add_to_variable_list = { name = lines target = scope:ac_forge_new_line } }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Player scope: throw away the board and the unfinished piece.
ac_forge_clear_board_effect = {
	if = { limit = { exists = var:ac_forge_item } destroy_artifact = var:ac_forge_item }
	var:ac_forge_board ?= { end_story = yes }
	remove_variable = ac_forge_board
	remove_variable = ac_forge_item
	remove_variable = ac_forge_current
	remove_variable = ac_forge_moves
}

# Player scope: close the Soul Forge, abandoning any unfinished piece.
ac_forge_close_effect = {
	ac_forge_clear_board_effect = yes
	remove_variable = ac_forge_rerolls
	remove_variable = ac_forge_template
	remove_variable = ac_forge_smith
	remove_variable = ac_forge_open
}

# Player scope, scope:story: work the step.
ac_forge_step_effect = {
	ac_forge_save_scopes_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { exists = var:ac_forge_current }
		var:ac_forge_current = { every_in_list = { variable = lines limit = { OR = { var:start_node = scope:story var:end_node = scope:story } } set_variable = { name = opacity value = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = ac_forge_moves } change_variable = { name = ac_forge_moves add = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = ac_forge_moves value = 1 } }
	}
	scope:story = { set_variable = ac_forge_used }
	set_variable = { name = ac_forge_current value = scope:story }
	if = { limit = { scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:start } custom_tooltip = ac_forge_node_start_desc scope:ac_forge_item = { set_max_durability = { value = scope:ac_forge_owner.ac_forge_base_durability } if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:armor } add_artifact_modifier = ac_eq_armor_modifier } } }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:temper } custom_tooltip = ac_forge_node_temper_desc scope:ac_forge_owner = { remove_short_term_gold = 5 } scope:ac_forge_item = { set_max_durability = { value = artifact_max_durability add = 15 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:hone } custom_tooltip = ac_forge_node_hone_desc scope:ac_forge_owner = { remove_short_term_gold = 10 } scope:ac_forge_item = { ac_forge_add_quality_effect = yes } }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:plates } custom_tooltip = ac_forge_node_plates_desc scope:ac_forge_owner = { remove_short_term_gold = 10 } scope:ac_forge_item = { ac_forge_add_quality_effect = yes } }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:fold } custom_tooltip = ac_forge_node_fold_desc scope:ac_forge_owner = { remove_short_term_gold = 5 } scope:ac_forge_item = { ac_forge_add_quality_effect = yes set_max_durability = { value = artifact_max_durability add = -10 min = 10 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:balance } custom_tooltip = ac_forge_node_balance_desc scope:ac_forge_owner = { remove_short_term_gold = 5 } scope:ac_forge_item = { add_artifact_modifier = ac_forge_balance_modifier set_variable = ac_forge_did_balance } }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:decorate } custom_tooltip = ac_forge_node_decorate_desc scope:ac_forge_owner = { remove_short_term_gold = 15 } scope:ac_forge_item = { add_artifact_modifier = artifact_monthly_minor_prestige_2_modifier set_variable = ac_forge_did_decorate } }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:reinforcement } custom_tooltip = ac_forge_node_reinforcement_desc scope:ac_forge_item = { set_max_durability = { value = artifact_max_durability add = 40 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:armory } custom_tooltip = ac_forge_node_armory_desc scope:ac_forge_owner = { remove_short_term_gold = 10 } scope:ac_forge_item = { add_artifact_modifier = artifact_knight_effectiveness_3_modifier set_variable = ac_forge_did_armory } }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:runes } custom_tooltip = ac_forge_node_runes_desc scope:ac_forge_owner = { remove_short_term_gold = 10 } scope:ac_forge_item = { add_artifact_modifier = ac_forge_runes_modifier set_variable = ac_forge_did_runes } }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:refine } custom_tooltip = ac_forge_node_refine_desc scope:ac_forge_owner = { remove_short_term_gold = 10 } scope:ac_forge_item = { ac_forge_add_quality_effect = yes set_max_durability = { value = artifact_max_durability add = 20 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:mat_jade } custom_tooltip = ac_forge_node_mat_jade_desc scope:ac_forge_owner = { remove_short_term_gold = 100 } scope:ac_forge_item = { set_variable = { name = ac_forged_material value = flag:jade } set_variable = { name = ac_core_soul value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ac_core_power value = 1 } set_artifact_description = ac_eq_desc_jade } }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:mat_beastbone } custom_tooltip = ac_forge_node_mat_beastbone_desc scope:ac_forge_owner = { remove_short_term_gold = 80 } scope:ac_forge_item = { set_variable = { name = ac_forged_material value = flag:beastbone } set_variable = { name = ac_core_fortitude value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ac_core_agility value = 1 } set_artifact_description = ac_eq_desc_beastbone } }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:mat_snowsteel } custom_tooltip = ac_forge_node_mat_snowsteel_desc scope:ac_forge_owner = { remove_short_term_gold = 120 } scope:ac_forge_item = { set_variable = { name = ac_forged_material value = flag:snowsteel } set_variable = { name = ac_core_fortitude value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ac_core_soul value = 1 } set_artifact_description = ac_eq_desc_snowsteel } }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:mat_truegold } custom_tooltip = ac_forge_node_mat_truegold_desc scope:ac_forge_owner = { remove_short_term_gold = 140 } scope:ac_forge_item = { set_variable = { name = ac_forged_material value = flag:truegold } set_variable = { name = ac_core_power value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ac_core_agility value = 1 } set_artifact_description = ac_eq_desc_truegold } }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:treasure_athletics } custom_tooltip = ac_forge_node_treasure_athletics_desc scope:ac_forge_owner = { ac_forge_take_treasure_effect = yes } scope:ac_forge_item = { set_variable = { name = ac_soul_treasure_ap value = scope:ac_forge_treasure_ap } add_artifact_modifier = ac_eq_treasure_athletics_modifier } }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:treasure_insight } custom_tooltip = ac_forge_node_treasure_insight_desc scope:ac_forge_owner = { ac_forge_take_treasure_effect = yes } scope:ac_forge_item = { set_variable = { name = ac_soul_treasure_ap value = scope:ac_forge_treasure_ap } add_artifact_modifier = ac_eq_treasure_insight_modifier } }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:treasure_persuasion } custom_tooltip = ac_forge_node_treasure_persuasion_desc scope:ac_forge_owner = { ac_forge_take_treasure_effect = yes } scope:ac_forge_item = { set_variable = { name = ac_soul_treasure_ap value = scope:ac_forge_treasure_ap } add_artifact_modifier = ac_eq_treasure_persuasion_modifier } }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:treasure_deception } custom_tooltip = ac_forge_node_treasure_deception_desc scope:ac_forge_owner = { ac_forge_take_treasure_effect = yes } scope:ac_forge_item = { set_variable = { name = ac_soul_treasure_ap value = scope:ac_forge_treasure_ap } add_artifact_modifier = ac_eq_treasure_deception_modifier } }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:treasure_craft } custom_tooltip = ac_forge_node_treasure_craft_desc scope:ac_forge_owner = { ac_forge_take_treasure_effect = yes } scope:ac_forge_item = { set_variable = { name = ac_soul_treasure_ap value = scope:ac_forge_treasure_ap } add_artifact_modifier = ac_eq_treasure_craft_modifier } }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:treasure_handseals } custom_tooltip = ac_forge_node_treasure_handseals_desc scope:ac_forge_owner = { ac_forge_take_treasure_effect = yes } scope:ac_forge_item = { set_variable = { name = ac_soul_treasure_ap value = scope:ac_forge_treasure_ap } add_artifact_modifier = ac_eq_treasure_handseals_modifier } }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:infuse_darkness } custom_tooltip = ac_forge_node_infuse_darkness_desc scope:ac_forge_owner = { remove_short_term_gold = 10 } scope:ac_forge_item = { set_variable = { name = ac_infused value = flag:darkness } add_artifact_modifier = ac_forge_infused_modifier } }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:infuse_earth } custom_tooltip = ac_forge_node_infuse_earth_desc scope:ac_forge_owner = { remove_short_term_gold = 10 } scope:ac_forge_item = { set_variable = { name = ac_infused value = flag:earth } add_artifact_modifier = ac_forge_infused_modifier } }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:infuse_fire } custom_tooltip = ac_forge_node_infuse_fire_desc scope:ac_forge_owner = { remove_short_term_gold = 10 } scope:ac_forge_item = { set_variable = { name = ac_infused value = flag:fire } add_artifact_modifier = ac_forge_infused_modifier } }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:infuse_ice } custom_tooltip = ac_forge_node_infuse_ice_desc scope:ac_forge_owner = { remove_short_term_gold = 10 } scope:ac_forge_item = { set_variable = { name = ac_infused value = flag:ice } add_artifact_modifier = ac_forge_infused_modifier } }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:infuse_light } custom_tooltip = ac_forge_node_infuse_light_desc scope:ac_forge_owner = { remove_short_term_gold = 10 } scope:ac_forge_item = { set_variable = { name = ac_infused value = flag:light } add_artifact_modifier = ac_forge_infused_modifier } }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:infuse_storm } custom_tooltip = ac_forge_node_infuse_storm_desc scope:ac_forge_owner = { remove_short_term_gold = 10 } scope:ac_forge_item = { set_variable = { name = ac_infused value = flag:storm } add_artifact_modifier = ac_forge_infused_modifier } }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:infuse_water } custom_tooltip = ac_forge_node_infuse_water_desc scope:ac_forge_owner = { remove_short_term_gold = 10 } scope:ac_forge_item = { set_variable = { name = ac_infused value = flag:water } add_artifact_modifier = ac_forge_infused_modifier } }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:story.var:ac_forge_node = flag:infuse_wind } custom_tooltip = ac_forge_node_infuse_wind_desc scope:ac_forge_owner = { remove_short_term_gold = 10 } scope:ac_forge_item = { set_variable = { name = ac_infused value = flag:wind } add_artifact_modifier = ac_forge_infused_modifier } }
}

# Player scope: finish the piece and hand it over.
ac_forge_finish_effect = {
	ac_forge_save_scopes_effect = yes
	scope:ac_forge_item = {
		remove_variable = ac_forge_unfinished
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ac_forged_material } } set_variable = { name = ac_forged_material value = flag:steel } set_artifact_description = ac_eq_desc_steel }
		if = { limit = { OR = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:katana var:ac_forged_kind = flag:jian var:ac_forged_kind = flag:tanto var:ac_forged_kind = flag:kunai var:ac_forged_kind = flag:qiang var:ac_forged_kind = flag:greataxe var:ac_forged_kind = flag:kusarigama } } set_variable = ac_bladed }
		# A superior-grade Soul Treasure fuels the material's first Core again.
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = ac_soul_treasure_ap var:ac_soul_treasure_ap >= ac_eq_superior_treasure_ap }
			if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_material = flag:jade } change_variable = { name = ac_core_soul add = 1 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_material = flag:beastbone } change_variable = { name = ac_core_fortitude add = 1 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_material = flag:snowsteel } change_variable = { name = ac_core_fortitude add = 1 } }
			else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_material = flag:truegold } change_variable = { name = ac_core_power add = 1 } }
			else = { set_variable = { name = ac_core_power value = 1 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { ac_forge_quality_points >= 5 } add_artifact_modifier = ac_eq_mastercrafted_modifier set_variable = { name = ac_forged_tier value = flag:mastercrafted } set_artifact_rarity = illustrious }
		else_if = { limit = { ac_forge_quality_points >= 3 } add_artifact_modifier = ac_eq_superior_modifier set_variable = { name = ac_forged_tier value = flag:superior } set_artifact_rarity = famed }
		else_if = { limit = { ac_forge_quality_points >= 1 } add_artifact_modifier = ac_eq_improved_modifier set_variable = { name = ac_forged_tier value = flag:improved } set_artifact_rarity = masterwork }
		else_if = { limit = { ac_forge_quality_points >= 0 } add_artifact_modifier = ac_eq_plain_modifier set_variable = { name = ac_forged_tier value = flag:plain } set_artifact_rarity = common }
		ac_eq_name_artifact_effect = yes
		add_durability = artifact_max_durability
		remove_variable = ac_forge_quality
	}
	scope:ac_forge_smith = { add_stewardship_lifestyle_xp = 100 }
	set_variable = { name = ac_forge_cooldown value = yes years = 1 }
	save_scope_as = ac_eq_owner
	scope:ac_forge_item = { save_scope_as = ac_eq_new }
	# The finished piece is no longer the board's to destroy.
	remove_variable = ac_forge_item
	ac_forge_close_effect = yes
	trigger_event = ac_forge.0020
}

# Artifact scope: name it after its kind, material and grade.
ac_eq_name_artifact_effect = {
	if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:katana var:ac_forged_material = flag:steel var:ac_forged_tier = flag:plain } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_katana_steel_plain }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:katana var:ac_forged_material = flag:steel var:ac_forged_tier = flag:improved } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_katana_steel_improved }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:katana var:ac_forged_material = flag:steel var:ac_forged_tier = flag:superior } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_katana_steel_superior }

	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:claws var:ac_forged_material = flag:truegold var:ac_forged_tier = flag:plain } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_claws_truegold_plain }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:claws var:ac_forged_material = flag:truegold var:ac_forged_tier = flag:improved } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_claws_truegold_improved }

	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:yumi var:ac_forged_material = flag:steel var:ac_forged_tier = flag:superior } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_yumi_steel_superior }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:yumi var:ac_forged_material = flag:steel var:ac_forged_tier = flag:mastercrafted } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_yumi_steel_mastercrafted }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:yumi var:ac_forged_material = flag:jade var:ac_forged_tier = flag:plain } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_yumi_jade_plain }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:yumi var:ac_forged_material = flag:jade var:ac_forged_tier = flag:improved } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_yumi_jade_improved }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:yumi var:ac_forged_material = flag:jade var:ac_forged_tier = flag:superior } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_yumi_jade_superior }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:yumi var:ac_forged_material = flag:jade var:ac_forged_tier = flag:mastercrafted } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_yumi_jade_mastercrafted }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:yumi var:ac_forged_material = flag:beastbone var:ac_forged_tier = flag:plain } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_yumi_beastbone_plain }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:yumi var:ac_forged_material = flag:beastbone var:ac_forged_tier = flag:improved } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_yumi_beastbone_improved }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:yumi var:ac_forged_material = flag:beastbone var:ac_forged_tier = flag:superior } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_yumi_beastbone_superior }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:yumi var:ac_forged_material = flag:beastbone var:ac_forged_tier = flag:mastercrafted } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_yumi_beastbone_mastercrafted }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:yumi var:ac_forged_material = flag:snowsteel var:ac_forged_tier = flag:plain } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_yumi_snowsteel_plain }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:yumi var:ac_forged_material = flag:snowsteel var:ac_forged_tier = flag:improved } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_yumi_snowsteel_improved }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:yumi var:ac_forged_material = flag:snowsteel var:ac_forged_tier = flag:superior } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_yumi_snowsteel_superior }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:yumi var:ac_forged_material = flag:snowsteel var:ac_forged_tier = flag:mastercrafted } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_yumi_snowsteel_mastercrafted }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:yumi var:ac_forged_material = flag:truegold var:ac_forged_tier = flag:plain } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_yumi_truegold_plain }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:yumi var:ac_forged_material = flag:truegold var:ac_forged_tier = flag:improved } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_yumi_truegold_improved }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:yumi var:ac_forged_material = flag:truegold var:ac_forged_tier = flag:superior } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_yumi_truegold_superior }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:yumi var:ac_forged_material = flag:truegold var:ac_forged_tier = flag:mastercrafted } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_yumi_truegold_mastercrafted }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:armor var:ac_forged_material = flag:steel var:ac_forged_tier = flag:plain } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_armor_steel_plain }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:armor var:ac_forged_material = flag:steel var:ac_forged_tier = flag:improved } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_armor_steel_improved }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:armor var:ac_forged_material = flag:steel var:ac_forged_tier = flag:superior } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_armor_steel_superior }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:armor var:ac_forged_material = flag:steel var:ac_forged_tier = flag:mastercrafted } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_armor_steel_mastercrafted }

	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:armor var:ac_forged_material = flag:jade var:ac_forged_tier = flag:superior } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_armor_jade_superior }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:armor var:ac_forged_material = flag:jade var:ac_forged_tier = flag:mastercrafted } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_armor_jade_mastercrafted }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:armor var:ac_forged_material = flag:beastbone var:ac_forged_tier = flag:plain } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_armor_beastbone_plain }

	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:armor var:ac_forged_material = flag:beastbone var:ac_forged_tier = flag:superior } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_armor_beastbone_superior }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:armor var:ac_forged_material = flag:beastbone var:ac_forged_tier = flag:mastercrafted } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_armor_beastbone_mastercrafted }

	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:armor var:ac_forged_material = flag:snowsteel var:ac_forged_tier = flag:superior } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_armor_snowsteel_superior }
	else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:armor var:ac_forged_material = flag:snowsteel var:ac_forged_tier = flag:mastercrafted } set_artifact_name = ac_eq_armor_snowsteel_mastercrafted }

# AI and seeding: forge at once for this character in $MATERIAL$, the kind following the Style.
ac_ai_forge_effect = {
	save_scope_as = ac_smith
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_eq_quality value = ac_eq_quality_value }
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ac_eq_wealth value = ac_eq_wealth_value }
	if = { limit = { has_trait = ac_style_akakiru } create_artifact = { name = ac_eq_katana_steel_plain description = ac_eq_desc_$MATERIAL$ type = ac_katana visuals = sword creator = this wealth = scope:ac_eq_wealth quality = scope:ac_eq_quality modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier save_scope_as = ac_eq_new } scope:ac_eq_new = { remove_artifact_modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier set_variable = { name = ac_forged_kind value = flag:katana } } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_trait = ac_style_aoyusumu } create_artifact = { name = ac_eq_bo_staff_steel_plain description = ac_eq_desc_$MATERIAL$ type = ac_bo_staff visuals = spear creator = this wealth = scope:ac_eq_wealth quality = scope:ac_eq_quality modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier save_scope_as = ac_eq_new } scope:ac_eq_new = { remove_artifact_modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier set_variable = { name = ac_forged_kind value = flag:bo_staff } } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_trait = ac_style_kiihakai } create_artifact = { name = ac_eq_jian_steel_plain description = ac_eq_desc_$MATERIAL$ type = ac_jian visuals = sword creator = this wealth = scope:ac_eq_wealth quality = scope:ac_eq_quality modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier save_scope_as = ac_eq_new } scope:ac_eq_new = { remove_artifact_modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier set_variable = { name = ac_forged_kind value = flag:jian } } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_trait = ac_style_kurokonton } create_artifact = { name = ac_eq_kunai_steel_plain description = ac_eq_desc_$MATERIAL$ type = ac_kunai visuals = dagger creator = this wealth = scope:ac_eq_wealth quality = scope:ac_eq_quality modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier save_scope_as = ac_eq_new } scope:ac_eq_new = { remove_artifact_modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier set_variable = { name = ac_forged_kind value = flag:kunai } } }
	else_if = { limit = { has_trait = ac_style_midorikatai } create_artifact = { name = ac_eq_claws_steel_plain description = ac_eq_desc_$MATERIAL$ type = ac_claws visuals = dagger creator = this wealth = scope:ac_eq_wealth quality = scope:ac_eq_quality modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier save_scope_as = ac_eq_new } scope:ac_eq_new = { remove_artifact_modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier set_variable = { name = ac_forged_kind value = flag:claws } } }
	else_if = { limit = { always = yes } create_artifact = { name = ac_eq_qiang_steel_plain description = ac_eq_desc_$MATERIAL$ type = ac_qiang visuals = spear creator = this wealth = scope:ac_eq_wealth quality = scope:ac_eq_quality modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier save_scope_as = ac_eq_new } scope:ac_eq_new = { remove_artifact_modifier = artifact_placeholder_modifier set_variable = { name = ac_forged_kind value = flag:qiang } } }
	scope:ac_eq_new = {
		set_variable = { name = ac_forged_material value = flag:$MATERIAL$ }
		if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_material = flag:jade } set_variable = { name = ac_core_soul value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ac_core_power value = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_material = flag:beastbone } set_variable = { name = ac_core_fortitude value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ac_core_agility value = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_material = flag:snowsteel } set_variable = { name = ac_core_fortitude value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ac_core_soul value = 1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:ac_forged_material = flag:truegold } set_variable = { name = ac_core_power value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ac_core_agility value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { OR = { var:ac_forged_kind = flag:katana var:ac_forged_kind = flag:jian var:ac_forged_kind = flag:tanto var:ac_forged_kind = flag:kunai var:ac_forged_kind = flag:qiang var:ac_forged_kind = flag:greataxe var:ac_forged_kind = flag:kusarigama } } set_variable = ac_bladed }
		if = { limit = { scope:ac_eq_quality >= 80 } add_artifact_modifier = ac_eq_mastercrafted_modifier set_variable = { name = ac_forged_tier value = flag:mastercrafted } }
		else_if = { limit = { scope:ac_eq_quality >= 60 } add_artifact_modifier = ac_eq_superior_modifier set_variable = { name = ac_forged_tier value = flag:superior } }
		else_if = { limit = { scope:ac_eq_quality >= 40 } add_artifact_modifier = ac_eq_improved_modifier set_variable = { name = ac_forged_tier value = flag:improved } }
		else_if = { limit = { scope:ac_eq_quality >= 0 } add_artifact_modifier = ac_eq_plain_modifier set_variable = { name = ac_forged_tier value = flag:plain } }
		ac_eq_name_artifact_effect = yes
	}
}

# AI cultivators with spare gold forge a weapon in the material that fuels their strongest Cores.
ac_ai_equipment_routine_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_trait = ac_cultivator
			is_adult = yes
			is_ai = yes
			NOT = { any_character_artifact = { has_variable = ac_forged_kind artifact_slot_type = primary_armament } }
			short_term_gold >= 250
		}
		random_list = {
			1 = { modifier = { add = ac_core_soul_rating } modifier = { add = ac_core_power_rating } remove_short_term_gold = ac_eq_jade_shards ac_ai_forge_effect = { MATERIAL = jade } }
			1 = { modifier = { add = ac_core_fortitude_rating } modifier = { add = ac_core_agility_rating } remove_short_term_gold = ac_eq_beastbone_shards ac_ai_forge_effect = { MATERIAL = beastbone } }
			1 = { modifier = { add = ac_core_fortitude_rating } modifier = { add = ac_core_soul_rating } remove_short_term_gold = ac_eq_snowsteel_shards ac_ai_forge_effect = { MATERIAL = snowsteel } }
			1 = { modifier = { add = ac_core_power_rating } modifier = { add = ac_core_agility_rating } remove_short_term_gold = ac_eq_truegold_shards ac_ai_forge_effect = { MATERIAL = truegold } }
		}
	}
}

# Duel: a critical blow on a foe in plain steel armour breaks it. Winner scope, foe in var:ac_duel_foe.
ac_eq_critical_effect = {
	var:ac_duel_foe = {
		random_equipped_character_artifact = {
			limit = { artifact_slot_type = armor NOT = { has_variable = ac_core_fortitude } NOT = { has_variable = ac_core_soul } NOT = { has_variable = ac_core_power } NOT = { has_variable = ac_core_agility } }
			add_durability = -50
		}
	}
}
